title: BuzzFeed, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-16
summary: BuzzFeed, Inc. dismissed Deloitte & Touche LLP as its independent auditor on April 13, 2026, and appointed CBIZ CPAs P.C. as successor. Deloitte's prior audit reports contained going-concern language and noted unresolved material weaknesses in internal control over financial reporting.
key_points: Deloitte & Touche LLP was dismissed as auditor on April 13, 2026 by BuzzFeed's Audit Committee
Deloitte's audit reports for fiscal years 2024 and 2025 included an explanatory paragraph expressing substantial doubt about BuzzFeed's ability to continue as a going concern
Material weaknesses in internal controls were identified: formalized IT general controls and controls surrounding the financial statement close process
CBIZ CPAs P.C. was engaged as the new auditor for fiscal year 2026
The filing includes Deloitte's letter (Exhibit 16.1) confirming agreement with the company's disclosures
why_it_matters: This is a routine corporate governance filing regarding an auditor change at a single media company. It has no relevance to broad market structure or macro catalysts that would affect financial markets broadly.
notes: Source is a routine SEC Form 8-K reporting an auditor change at BuzzFeed, Inc. Not relevant to market structure or macro catalysts. The document concerns single-company corporate governance and accounting matters with no broader market implications.
